exercises.question: Which sentence uses an impersonal construction? [¿Cuál usa una construcción impersonal?]
options: Se pulsa este botón para empezar. [This button is pressed to start.]
Yo pulso este botón para empezar. [I press this button to start.]
Pulsa este botón ayer. [He/She pressed this button yesterday.]

exercises.english: This button is pressed to start.

sentences: Se introduce la tarjeta. [The card is inserted.]

Se introduce la tarjeta y se pulsa el botón. [The card is inserted and the button is pressed.]

exercises.question: Which expression means «you have to follow the instructions»? [¿Qué expresión significa «hay que seguir las instrucciones»?]
options: Hay que seguir las instrucciones. [You have to follow the instructions.]
Se siguen ayer las instrucciones. [The instructions were followed yesterday.]
Hay instrucciones seguir. [There are instructions follow.]
